tasks.short: List the materials the job needs, fill the warehouse requisition form, check it, hand it in at the warehouse, and collect and check the materials.

steps.what: Electrician's helper lists the materials the job needs from the electrician's instructions
Electrician's helper fills the paper warehouse requisition form
Electrician's helper checks the final requisition: items and quantities match the electrician's list and the job
Electrician's helper sends the checked requisition to the warehouse: handed in on paper today, by one send from the app after the change
Electrician's helper collects and checks materials at the warehouse counter

tasks.design: The job in the field service app ({OPS_SYSTEM}) carries the electrician's material list, and the helper builds the requisition by picking items from the warehouse catalogue on a phone, so a paper form is not filled by hand. Once the helper has checked it, the helper sends the requisition to the warehouse system, which prepares the order before the helper arrives. Collecting and checking materials stay with the helper.
tasks.previous_blocker: Materials were listed and written on paper forms carried to the warehouse.
tasks.enabler_now: Field service apps hold material lists and send requisitions to the warehouse.
tasks.still_hard: Changes on site need extra requisitions.
tasks.human_edge: Spotting that the cable on the list is the wrong size for the job.

reach.learn: Whether orders can be prepared ahead.

evidence.claim: Field service apps can hold job material lists and send requisitions to a warehouse system.
Systems that record who requested what can monitor staff; national rules may require works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the job instructions to materials collected; buying from suppliers is outside.
Input contract: warehouse catalogue in the app; fallback is the paper form.
The helper checks every requisition. s1 keeps 50 because the electrician's list is on the job but still read and completed. s2 keeps 30 for picking items. s4 keeps 10 for the send.
The warehouse prepares orders in about the time it took to read paper forms.
research_questions: Does waiting time at the warehouse counter fall?

incremental.description: Electrician's helper makes extra requisitions for changes on site.

approvals.approved_version: The requisition with items and quantities exactly as checked by the helper in s3, sent once to the warehouse system for this job; any change needs a new check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many site changes, so the electrician's list is often incomplete and items are added by hand (23.0); high: well-planned jobs with set material lists (38.0).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The electrician's helper keeps collecting and checking materials and supporting the electrician; listing and paper forms shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A helper with more time on the job.
